messages:
sec-bot: Automated alert: vendor hsm-agent v2.4.1 -> remote code exec CVE-2026-XXXX detected in telemetry module. Affected hosts: hsm-proxy-prod-1..3. Logs attached.
alex.k: Uh — thanks. Is this the on-prem agent that watches the HSM control plane?
sec-bot: yes. telemetry module collects metrics and fetches vendor updates. exploit allows arbitrary command execution as 'hsm-agent' user.
maria_s: Can we immediately revoke agent update access and roll the agent credentials? +1 to isolating those hosts.
jordan: If the agent runs as non-root, scope is limited but still bad. Two quick asks: 1) RBAC audit for who can push vendor updates, 2) confirm that CMKs are never exported by the agent.
paul-crypto: Confirming: current agent has no KMS export path, but it has a proxy path to the HSM management interface. Need to verify vendor RPCs.
ops-sre: I'm starting a mitigation runbook. Plan: cordon hsm-proxy-prod-1..3, switch routing to warm standby pool, snapshot, then kill agent process. ETA 12m.
alex.k: For the RBAC step, let's tighten operator roles: temporary deny `hsm:update_agent` to everyone except a 2-person emergency group. Also enable `require_2fa` on those roles.
maria_s: I'll prepare the short-lived policy. Draft policy snippet:```yaml
- principal: emergency-hsm-admins
  allow: [hsm:reconfigure, hsm:rotate-credentials]
  require: [mfa, oncall-ack]
  ttl: 4h
```
sec-bot: Action logged: policy-change requested by maria_s.
ingrid-legal: Heads-up: if any customer CMKs were touched or exported, we need to notify compliance immediately (SOC2/PCI considerations). Who's owning the attestation?
paul-crypto: No exports observed in logs. Quick grep shows only management ops: `GET /status`, `POST /reload` RPCs from agent. Sample log: ```[2026-03-21T14:02:11Z] agent: rpc=fetch_updates src=10.12.3.21 cmd=check_update```
jordan: Good. Still run an integrity check of key material and re-derive attestation proofs. We should also increase audit retention for these hosts to 180 days for now.
ops-sre: On it. Updating ELK retention policy and pushing logs to S3 forensic bucket with immutability. Command I'm running: `kubectl patch ds hsm-agent -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"hsm-agent","image":"scratch"}]}}}}'` (this will kill agent pods)
alex.k: Also schedule a canary of the vendor-supplied patch in staging, but do not auto-deploy to prod. We need the vendor's fix + our workspace mitigation.
maria_s: New RBAC change applied to prod (temp deny -> only emergency-hsm-admins). Policy ID: pol-6299-temp-evict.
sec-bot: Policy-change event: pol-6299-temp-evict applied by maria_s at 2026-03-21T14:03:40Z.
paul-crypto: Recommend generating fresh operator keys for HSM management and rotating any session secrets that the agent used. I'll prep rotation commands.
ingrid-legal: Please keep audit trail of all actions and timeline. If any regulated customer data was in-flight during the exploit window (14:00-14:08), we may need to trigger breach workflow.
jordan: We're checking network capture and NCC. If nothing exfiltrated, we will still run a post-mortem and update control matrices.
ops-sre: Prod agents killed, traffic rerouted to warm pool, snapshots taken. Forensic dump uploaded to S3://redwood-forensics/6299000123/.
sec-bot: Forensic upload complete. Hash: sha256:abc123... (logged).
alex.k: Next steps: 1) vendor patch validation in staging; 2) short RBAC policy retained until patch validated + 24h; 3) extend log retention and start compliance notif draft. Assign: maria_s -> RBAC, paul-crypto -> key rotation, ops-sre -> infra forensics, jordan -> telemetry/audit, ingrid-legal -> notifications.
maria_s: Assigned. I'll also add an automated check to block vendor update RPCs unless signed by vendor cert v3.
ingrid-legal: I'll draft a notification timeline. We have 72h SLA to notify some customers depending on contract; will flag which ones.
paul-crypto: Rotation scripts ready, waiting for go from ops-sre to run safe rotation.
jordan: Putting together the postmortem template and the list of control changes (RBAC matrix, alerting thresholds, immutable logs).
ops-sre: All done for now. If anything changes, I'll @channel. :shield:
alex.k: Thanks team. Quick retrospective action: add a vendor-agent risk gating checklist to onboarding and require vulnerability scanning before agent approval.
sec-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-6299-hsm-agent-vuln. Links: https://tracker.internal/INC-6299
paul-crypto: One more note — add a periodic HSM attestation (every 24h) to detect any unauthorized management paths.
ingrid-legal: Keep me posted before any external comms.
ops-sre: Closing thread for now, will update ticket with timeline details.
